description: Official Kubb plugins that generate TypeScript types, TanStack Query and SWR hooks, Zod schemas, Faker mocks, MSW handlers, Cypress tests, MCP servers, and typed Axios or Fetch clients. The full Kubb documentation lives at https://kubb.dev and is indexed as /kubb-labs/docs.
rules: This repository holds the plugin packages only. For guides, configuration reference and per-plugin options, use https://kubb.dev or the /kubb-labs/docs library.
Kubb v5 has no `pluginOas()`. The OpenAPI adapter is the top-level `adapter` key and defaults to `adapterOas()` from `@kubb/adapter-oas`, which ships with `kubb`. Set `adapter` only to pass options.
`@kubb/plugin-client` was removed in v5. Register `pluginAxios` or `pluginFetch` and point query and MCP plugins at it with `client: 'axios' | 'fetch'`.
Passing your own `output` to a plugin replaces that plugin's default `output` object wholesale, so repeat `barrel` inside it to keep the plugin's barrel file.
